name: Remote commands
author: Brett
description: Molly's own client on the console-commands relay: Molly announces itself to the console server as app `molly` with its own catalog (its views and the apps' pages, settings tabs, dialogs and every action: molly.*, navigation.*, xlayout.*, the sign-in actions), so each one runs from the console API (POST /api/console/action with to: molly), the MCP tools console_open / console_action / console_list (to="molly"), the CLI (axf console action molly.reload, axf console list actions --to molly) and AmberX voice. Without a `to`, the relay sends a command to whichever open client has what it names. Needs the console token for Molly's origin (Settings → Plugins → Remote commands, or the Connections screen).

items.title: Remote commands status
items.description: Is Molly connected to the console's command relay: state (off, no-token, connecting, connected, denied, unreachable), client id, console origin, item count, last command.
items.output: { state, client, base, hasToken, items, last, lastAt }

items.title: Reconnect to the console
items.description: Drops the stream and says hello again (after a token change or a console restart).

items.title: Remote commands on / off
items.description: on | off (no value toggles). Off: Molly stops listening; the console inside it still takes its own commands.

items.title: A note per command on / off
items.description: on | off (no value toggles) for the toast that says who ran what.

items.title: Forget the console token
items.description: Removes the console token from this browser; Molly stops taking remote commands until a token is pasted again. Needs a confirm token.

commands.noReads: no data folder: the on/off and toast settings are per-device; the console token is a browser credential and is never read or set remotely
